title: Reading
description: One rival reading of one trend through one lens, written by a Rival Reader. A Reading has no field that could place it above its peers: no strength, likelihood, confidence or position. It is identified only by its trend and its lens. Shipped inside the trend's reveal bundle (data/reveal/<trendId>.js), never in a module that loads before the intuition record.

evidence.description: Claims that support this reading, each with its own dated source. Displayed oldest source first (C-4); array order carries no meaning.

counterEvidence.description: The strongest honest case against this reading, each claim with its own dated source. Same shape as evidence, deliberately: the case against is not a lesser kind of content.

disconfirmingCondition.description: The specific, observable event that would show this reading to be wrong.

claim.description: Paraphrase of what the source supports.

signalId.description: Optional link to the Signal the claim draws on, so the Verifier can cross-check.
